# openmetadata_api_endpoint Data Source

Looks up a single OpenMetadata API endpoint by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_api_endpoint" "list_pets" {
  fully_qualified_name = "payments-api.pets.list-pets"
}

output "list_pets_api_endpoint_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_api_endpoint.list_pets.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) API endpoint fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) API endpoint UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `api_collection` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent API collection.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `endpoint_url` (String) URL of the endpoint relative to the collection root.
- `name` (String) API endpoint name.
- `request_method` (String) HTTP method of the endpoint.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the API service.
- `service_type` (String) OpenMetadata API service type.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
